run_stable_diffusion_text_to_image: run stable diffusion text-to-image generation on HPU with a prompt and save output images
run_sdxl_image_generation: run SDXL text-to-image generation with HPU acceleration and optional second prompt
run_sd3_image_generation: run SD3 text-to-image generation with up to three prompts and distributed CFG support
run_flux_image_generation: run FLUX text-to-image generation on HPU with flow match euler scheduler
run_controlnet_image_generation: run stable diffusion with ControlNet using a canny edge conditioning image
